english: kahk (shortbread stuffed with dates and nuts)

examples.arabic: أمي عملت كحك حلو أوي وكلناه مع الشاي.
examples.english: My mom made very delicious kahk and we ate it with tea.
examples.transliteration: omy amalet kahk helw awy wa kalnah maa el shay.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: لما دخلت شمت ريحة كحك سخن وقهوة مظبوطة مالية المكان
examples.english: When I entered, I smelled the scent of hot kahk and perfectly brewed coffee filling the place.
examples.transliteration: Lamma dakhalet shammet rīḥet kaḥk sokhn w qahwa maẓboota malya el-makān.

examples.english: Then we ate a lot of sweet kahk.

examples.arabic: شربنا شاي اكلنا كحك وقضيت معاها وقت جميل قبل ما امشي
examples.english: We drank tea, ate kahk, and I spent a beautiful time with her before I left
examples.transliteration: Sheribnā shāy akalnā kaḥk w qaḍḍēt maʿāhā waqt gamīl qabl mā amshī
